217: def _is_valid_rpath(rpath: str, lib_dir: Path, wheel_base_dir: Path) -> bool:
218:     full_rpath_entry = _resolve_rpath_tokens(rpath, lib_dir)
219:     if not Path(full_rpath_entry).is_absolute():
220:         logger.debug(
221:             "rpath entry %s could not be resolved to an absolute path -- discarding it.",
222:             rpath,
223:         )
224:         return False
225:     if not is_subdir(full_rpath_entry, wheel_base_dir):
226:         logger.debug("rpath entry %s points outside the wheel -- discarding it.", rpath)
227:         return False
228:     logger.debug("Preserved rpath entry %s", rpath)
229:     return True

232: def _resolve_rpath_tokens(rpath: str, lib_base_dir: Path) -> str:
233:     # See https://www.man7.org/linux/man-pages/man8/ld.so.8.html#DESCRIPTION
234:     system_lib_dir = "lib64" if platform.architecture()[0] == "64bit" else "lib"
235:     system_processor_type = platform.machine()
236:     token_replacements = {
237:         "ORIGIN": str(lib_base_dir),
238:         "LIB": system_lib_dir,
239:         "PLATFORM": system_processor_type,
240:     }
241:     for token, target in token_replacements.items():
242:         rpath = rpath.replace(f"${token}", target)  # $TOKEN
243:         rpath = rpath.replace(f"${{{token}}}", target)  # ${TOKEN}
244:     return rpath

247: def _path_is_script(path: Path) -> bool:
248:     # Looks something like "uWSGI-2.0.21.data/scripts/uwsgi"
249:     components = path.parts
250:     return len(components) == 3 and components[0].endswith(".data") and components[1] == "scripts"

253: def _replace_elf_script_with_shim(package_name: str, orig_path: Path) -> Path:
254:     """Move an ELF script and replace it with a shim.
255: 
256:     We can't directly rewrite the RPATH of ELF executables in the "scripts"
257:     directory since scripts aren't installed to a consistent relative path to
258:     platlib files.
259: 
260:     Instead, we move the executable into a special directory in platlib and put
261:     a shim script in its place which execs the real executable.
262: 
263:     More context: https://github.com/pypa/auditwheel/issues/340
264: 
265:     Returns the new path of the moved executable.
266:     """
267:     scripts_dir = Path(f"{package_name}.scripts")
268:     scripts_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
269: 
270:     new_path = scripts_dir / orig_path.name
271:     orig_path.rename(new_path)
272: 
273:     with orig_path.open("w", newline="\n") as f:
274:         f.write(_script_shim(new_path))
275:     orig_path.chmod(new_path.stat().st_mode)
276: 
277:     return new_path

280: def _script_shim(binary_path: Path) -> str:

258:         apt_bin = cls.which("apt")
259:         apt_file_bin = cls.which("apt-file", allowed_returncodes={2})
260:         distro = cls.distro()
261:         assert apt_bin is not None and apt_file_bin is not None and distro is not None
262:         results = {}
263:         try:
264:             # $ echo '\n'.join(paths) | apt-file search --from-file -
265:             # Finding relevant cache files to search ...
266:             # ...
267:             # libwebpdemux2: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libwebpdemux.so.2.0.9
268:             stdout = subprocess.check_output(
269:                 [apt_file_bin, "search", "--from-file", "-"],
270:                 stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
271:                 input=b"\n".join(
272:                     [str(filepath).encode("utf-8") for filepath in filepaths]
273:                 ),
274:             ).decode()
275:             for package_name, filepath in _APT_FILE_SEARCH_RE.findall(stdout):
276:                 stdout = subprocess.check_output(
277:                     [apt_bin, "show", package_name],
278:                     stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
279:                 ).decode()
280:                 if match := _DPKG_VERSION_RE.search(stdout):
281:                     package_version = match.group(1)
282:                     results[filepath] = ProvidedBy(
283:                         package_type="deb",
284:                         distro=distro,

287:                     )
288:         except subprocess.CalledProcessError:

293: def _package_providers() -> list[type[PackageProvider]]:
294:     """Returns a list of package providers sorted in
295:     the order that they should be attempted.
296:     """
297: 
298:     def all_subclasses(cls):
299:         subclasses = set()
300:         for subcls in cls.__subclasses__():
301:             subclasses.add(subcls)
302:             subclasses |= all_subclasses(subcls)
303:         return subclasses
304: 
305:     return sorted(all_subclasses(PackageProvider), key=lambda p: p._resolve_order)
306: 
307: 
308: def whichprovides(filepath: typing.Union[str, list[str]]) -> dict[str, ProvidedBy]:
309:     """Return a package URL (PURL) for the package that provides a file"""
310:     if isinstance(filepath, str):
311:         filepaths = [filepath]
312:     else:
313:         filepaths = filepath
314: 
315:     # Link between the original path to the resolved
316:     # path and then allocate a structure for results.
317:     resolved_filepaths = {
318:         str(pathlib.Path(filepath).resolve()): filepath for filepath in filepaths
319:     }
320:     filepath_provided_by: dict[str, ProvidedBy] = {}
321:     for package_provider in _package_providers():
322:         remaining = set(resolved_filepaths) - set(filepath_provided_by)
323:         if not remaining:
324:             break
325:         if not package_provider.is_available():
326:             continue
327:         results = package_provider.whichprovides(remaining)
328:         filepath_provided_by.update(results)
329: 
330:     return {
331:         resolved_filepaths[filepath]: value
332:         for filepath, value in filepath_provided_by.items()
333:     }

354:             exit_code = 1
